items.statement: An agent cannot rely on the deny list to keep test directories out of an agent's reach because the prohibitions section of AGENTS.md does not name test/.
An agent cannot know every variable the code needs before running it because 2 referenced key(s) are absent from any committed example file: UDA_LOG_LEVEL, UDA_LOG_LEVELNumber.
An agent cannot discover the codebase through an MCP index because no MCP configuration names codebase-memory-mcp for this repository.
An agent cannot trust that a future .env stays out of history because ignore rules are incomplete (missing: dotenv variant).
An agent cannot know where permanent and scratch documentation live because AGENTS.md does not name docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md.
An agent cannot keep code and its documentation in step because no definition-of-done sentence ties a documentation trigger to the same change set.
An agent cannot diff today's findings against an accepted baseline because quality tooling is configured but no baseline or suppression artifact is committed.
An agent cannot state how many violations exist today because a counting surface exists but no numeric violation budget or count is committed.
An agent cannot stop the violation count from growing because no baseline, budget or comparison step exists, so the count is not guarded.
An agent cannot know when coverage drops below an agreed floor because no coverage threshold is configured in the test runner.
An agent cannot check a workflow change before it is pushed because no linter for the github workflow files runs locally or in CI.
An agent cannot find the canonical authoring rules for documentation because docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md does not exist.

An agent cannot trust that secret shapes cannot be committed because ignore rules are incomplete (missing: dotenv variant, ssh private key, PEM, key, PKCS#12, PFX, keystore, certificate (.crt), certificate (.cer), AWS credentials).
An agent cannot rely on local hooks to run before a commit because no hook manager is configured.

An agent cannot assume every harness on the team sees the project rules because 20 of 28 known harnesses reach an instruction file; Aider, Amazon Q Developer, Anthropic Claude Code, Continue, Google Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Replit Agent, Void reach nothing.
An agent cannot report to people or ask them for a decision in a form they expect because AGENTS.md has no section on writing for people and names no communication rules file.
An agent cannot find the decisions of record because no ADR directory (docs/architecture/adrs/ or docs/adr/) exists.
An agent cannot rely on the documentation reading clearly to a new engineer because 13.5% of sentences are over 25 words (pass: at most 10%).
An agent cannot file a change with the information reviewers need because no .github/pull_request_template file exists.
An agent cannot report a bug or request in a structured way because no .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE entry exists.
An agent cannot contribute without reverse-engineering the process because no CONTRIBUTING document exists.
An agent cannot report a vulnerability responsibly because no SECURITY document exists at the root, under .github/, .gitlab/ or docs/.

An agent cannot rely on the update policy reaching security updates because the `github-actions` entry sets `target-branch` together with `groups`, and Dependabot drops those options for security updates, which always go to the default branch.

An agent cannot rely on the update policy reaching security updates because the `npm` entry sets `target-branch` together with `groups`, and Dependabot drops those options for security updates, which always go to the default branch.

An agent cannot rely on the update policy reaching security updates because the `npm` entry sets `target-branch` together with `groups`, and Dependabot drops those options for security updates, which always go to the default branch.
An agent cannot reproduce the protected-branch rules as code because the github provider is detected but no branch-protection configuration exists.
An agent cannot orient itself from a map instead of exploring blindly because no docs/architecture/, ADR directory or diagram exists.
An agent cannot learn a bad commit subject before it pushes because the Conventional Commits rule is enforced only on the pull-request title in CI, and no local commit-message rule exists.
An agent cannot trust every specific line of AGENTS.md because three of them name a command, a file or a state that does not resolve (npm test:coverage, __mocks__/sweetAlert2.ts, a root .env).
An agent cannot read intent from the source of every exported symbol because 89 of 266 exported TypeScript declarations (33%) have no doc comment.
